summary: Request to implement Trusted Publishing for PyPI uploads to reduce supply chain attack risks. The team acknowledges this as a priority but requires an overhaul of the release process.
userImpact: Users gain reduced supply chain attack risk when package publishing uses Trusted Publishing authentication.
proposedFix: Implement Trusted Publishing by overhauling the release process to use OIDC-based authentication for PyPI uploads.
keyQuote: We're aware of this and have it as a near term item to do
